# Pandas for Data Science and Machine Learning

A practical learning repository documenting my journey of learning **Pandas**, one of the essential Python libraries for Data Analysis, Data Science, and Machine Learning.

The goal of this repository is to develop strong data manipulation and analysis skills and understand how to work with real-world datasets before building Machine Learning models.

## 🎯 Learning Objectives

- Understand Pandas fundamentals and its importance in Data Science.
- Work with Pandas Series and DataFrames.
- Create DataFrames from different data sources.
- Explore and understand real-world datasets.
- Perform data selection, filtering, and indexing.
- Identify missing values, duplicates, and inconsistent data.
- Clean and transform datasets.
- Perform data analysis and statistical operations.
- Prepare datasets for Machine Learning.

## 📚 Learning Roadmap

### Phase 01 – Pandas Fundamentals
- Introduction to Pandas
- Why Pandas?
- Pandas features and applications
- Pandas Series vs DataFrame
- Pandas data structures

### Phase 02 – Pandas Series
- Introduction to Series
- Creating Series in different ways
- Series indexing
- Series attributes and properties
- Series data types (`dtype`)
- Series operations

### Phase 03 – Pandas DataFrame
- Introduction to DataFrame
- Creating DataFrames
- Loading data from different sources
- DataFrame structure
- DataFrame attributes and properties
- DataFrame indexing and selection

### Phase 04 – Exploring and Understanding Datasets
- Understanding dataset structure
- Inspecting datasets
- Dataset dimensions and information
- Understanding columns and data types
- Descriptive statistics
- Identifying data quality issues

### Upcoming Phases
- Data Selection and Filtering
- Data Cleaning and Preprocessing
- Handling Missing Values
- Handling Duplicate Records
- Data Transformation
- GroupBy and Aggregation
- Combining and Merging DataFrames
- Working with Real-World Datasets
- Data Preparation for Machine Learning

## 🛠️ Technologies and Tools

- Python
- Pandas
- NumPy
- Jupyter Notebook
- Google Colab
- Git and GitHub

## 💻 Learning Approach

My learning approach focuses on:

- Understanding concepts rather than memorizing functions.
- Writing practical Python code.
- Working with real-world datasets.
- Solving data manipulation problems.
- Connecting Pandas concepts with Data Science and Machine Learning applications.

## 🚀 Long-Term Goal

To build strong foundations in Data Analysis and Data Science, develop practical skills in data preprocessing, and eventually use these skills to build real-world Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence applications.

This repository will be continuously updated as I progress in my Pandas learning journey.
